title: I Am the Eagle-shaped Pottery Ding
synopsis: Learn about the story of this special national treasure, that now resides in the National Museum of China.

fullText.simplified:
我是鹰形陶鼎

    你好，我是一个鼎，来自5000-7000年以前。具体是哪一年，我已经记不清了，我活了太久了。我见过人类原始的模样，也见过历史的沧桑变化。我长得像什么？我想你已经看出来了。没错，我长得像一只鹰，如今的你们叫我“鹰形陶鼎”。因为我的样子很可爱，受到了很多人的欢迎，现在的你们也喜欢叫我国宝。但其实在很久以前，我给人的第一印象并不是可爱，而是王者的霸气。所以，请你再仔细看看我。虽然我有点儿胖，但你能从我的身上感受到王者之气吗？
    我刚出生的时候，人类还住在泥和草做的草房里，他们养狗、养猪，也种地。虽然生活简单，但大家都要很努力才能活下来。人们用我来装食物和水，我和他们在一起生活了很多年。后来发生了很多变化，那些人都不在了，我流浪了很多地方。在流浪的过程中，我又认识了一些人，其中有位女士很喜欢我。这位女士是个成功人士，大家都很尊敬她。后来这位女士也死了，我为了陪这位女士，和她一起被埋进了土里。
    我在土里睡了一觉，看不到太阳，也看不到月亮。这一觉睡了几千年，直到1957年，有个农民在种地时发现了我。他把我带回了家，但是有点儿遗憾，他不认识我。他用我来装谷子，来喂养他的鸡。我在这位农民的家里住了一年。第二年，有位大学生来到农民家，他看到了我。我太喜欢这位大学生了，他太有眼光了。他看出了我的不同之处，高兴地把我带到了北京。后来，经过研究，你们终于知道了我的来历。几千年过去了，很多东西都消失了。我没有对人说过以前的事，但你们通过自己的研究知道了以前的事，并且还能这样懂我，你们真是太厉害了。
    现在，我住在北京的“中国国家博物馆”里。这儿是我的新家，我想我会一直在这儿住下去。欢迎你来北京看我。
fullText.traditional:
我是鷹形陶鼎

    你好，我是一個鼎，來自5000-7000年以前。具體是哪一年，我已經記不清了，我活了太久了。我見過人類原始的模樣，也見過歷史的滄桑變化。我長得像什麼？我想你已經看出來了。沒錯，我長得像一隻鷹，如今的你們叫我“鷹形陶鼎”。因為我的樣子很可愛，受到了很多人的歡迎，現在的你們也喜歡叫我國寶。但其實在很久以前，我給人的第一印象並不是可愛，而是王者的霸氣。所以，請你再仔細看看我。雖然我有點兒胖，但你能從我的身上感受到王者之氣嗎？
    我剛出生的時候，人類還住在泥和草做的草房裡，他們養狗、養豬，也種地。雖然生活簡單，但大家都要很努力才能活下來。人們用我來裝食物和水，我和他們在一起生活了很多年。後來發生了很多變化，那些人都不在了，我流浪了很多地方。在流浪的過程中，我又認識了一些人，其中有位女士很喜歡我。這位女士是個成功人士，大家都很尊敬她。後來這位女士也死了，我為了陪這位女士，和她一起被埋進了土裡。
    我在土裡睡了一覺，看不到太陽，也看不到月亮。這一覺睡了幾千年，直到1957年，有個農民在種地時發現了我。他把我帶回了家，但是有點兒遺憾，他不認識我。他用我來裝穀子，來餵養他的雞。我在這位農民的家裡住了一年。第二年，有位大學生來到農民家，他看到了我。我太喜歡這位大學生了，他太有眼光了。他看出了我的不同之處，高興地把我帶到了北京。後來，經過研究，你們終於知道了我的來歷。幾千年過去了，很多東西都消失了。我沒有對人說過以前的事，但你們通過自己的研究知道了以前的事，並且還能這樣懂我，你們真是太厲害了。
    現在，我住在北京的“中國國家博物館”裡。這兒是我的新家，我想我會一直在這兒住下去。歡迎你來北京看我。

sentences.simplified: 我长得像什么？我想你已经看出来了。
sentences.traditional: 我長得像什麼？我想你已經看出來了。

sentences.english: I’ve seen what mankind was like in primitive times, and I have also witnessed the vicissitudes of history.

sentences.simplified: 没错，我长得像一只鹰，如今的你们叫我“鹰形陶鼎”。

sentences.simplified: 因为我的样子很可爱，受到了很多人的欢迎，现在的你们也喜欢叫我国宝。
sentences.traditional: 因為我的樣子很可愛，受到了很多人的歡迎，現在的你們也喜歡叫我國寶。

sentences.english: That’s right, I look like an eagle, and today you call me the “eagle-shaped pottery ding”.

sentences.simplified: 但其实在很久以前，我给人的第一印象并不是可爱，而是王者的霸气。
sentences.traditional: 但其實在很久以前，我給人的第一印象並不是可愛，而是王者的霸氣。

sentences.english: I am very popular because of my cute appearance. Nowadays, you also like to call me a national treasure.

sentences.simplified: 所以，请你再仔细看看我。虽然我有点儿胖，但你能从我的身上感受到王者之气吗？
sentences.traditional: 所以，請你再仔細看看我。雖然我有點兒胖，但你能從我的身上感受到王者之氣嗎？

sentences.english: But actually, a long time ago, the first impression I gave people was not cuteness but the domineering aura of a king.
So, please take a closer look at me. Although I’m a little chubby, can you feel the aura of a king from me?

sentences.traditional: 他們養狗、養豬，也種地。
sentences.pinyin: tā men yǎng gǒu yǎng zhū yě zhòng dì
sentences.english: When I was first born, people were still living in thatched huts made from mud and grass.

sentences.simplified: 虽然生活简单，但大家都要很努力才能活下来。
sentences.traditional: 雖然生活簡單，但大家都要很努力才能活下來。

sentences.traditional: 人們用我來裝食物和水，我和他們在一起生活了很多年。

sentences.english: Even though life was simple, everyone had to work very hard to survive.

sentences.simplified: 后来发生了很多变化，那些人都不在了，我流浪了很多地方。
sentences.traditional: 後來發生了很多變化，那些人都不在了，我流浪了很多地方。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái fā shēng le hěn duō biàn huà nà xiē rén dōu bú zài le wǒ liú làng le hěn duō dì fang
sentences.english: People used me to hold food and water. I lived with them for many years.

sentences.simplified: 在流浪的过程中，我又认识了一些人，其中有位女士很喜欢我。
sentences.traditional: 在流浪的過程中，我又認識了一些人，其中有位女士很喜歡我。
sentences.pinyin: zài liú làng de guò chéng zhōng wǒ yòu rèn shi le yì xiē rén qí zhōng yǒu wèi nǚ shì hěn xǐ huan wǒ
sentences.english: Then, many changes happened. Those people passed away, and I wandered around many places.

sentences.simplified: 这位女士是个成功人士，大家都很尊敬她。
sentences.traditional: 這位女士是個成功人士，大家都很尊敬她。
sentences.pinyin: zhè wèi nǚ shì shì ge chéng gōng rén shì dà jiā dōu hěn zūn jìng tā
sentences.english: I met some people when I was wandering. Among them, there was a lady who liked me a lot.

sentences.simplified: 后来这位女士也死了，我为了陪这位女士，和她一起被埋进了土里。
sentences.traditional: 後來這位女士也死了，我為了陪這位女士，和她一起被埋進了土裡。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái zhè wèi nǚ shì yě sǐ le wǒ wèi le péi zhè wèi nǚ shì hé tā yì qǐ bèi mái jìn le tǔ lǐ
sentences.english: This lady was a successful person, and everyone respected her.
Later, this lady also died. To accompany her, I was buried in the earth with her.

sentences.simplified: 我在土里睡了一觉，看不到太阳，也看不到月亮。
sentences.traditional: 我在土裡睡了一覺，看不到太陽，也看不到月亮。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài tǔ lǐ shuì le yí jiào kàn bú dào tài yáng yě kàn bú dào yuè liang

sentences.simplified: 这一觉睡了几千年，直到1957年，有个农民在种地时发现了我。
sentences.traditional: 這一覺睡了幾千年，直到1957年，有個農民在種地時發現了我。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí jiào shuì le jǐ qiān nián zhí dào 4 nián yǒu ge nóng mín zài zhòng dì shí fā xiàn le wǒ
sentences.english: I slept in the soil, unable to see the sun or the moon.

sentences.simplified: 他把我带回了家，但是有点儿遗憾，他不认识我。
sentences.traditional: 他把我帶回了家，但是有點兒遺憾，他不認識我。
sentences.pinyin: tā bǎ wǒ dài huí le jiā dàn shì yǒu diǎn'r yí hàn tā bú rèn shi wǒ
sentences.english: I slept for several thousand years until 1957, when a farmer discovered me while farming.

sentences.simplified: 他用我来装谷子，来喂养他的鸡。我在这位农民的家里住了一年。
sentences.traditional: 他用我來裝穀子，來餵養他的雞。我在這位農民的家裡住了一年。
sentences.pinyin: tā yòng wǒ lái zhuāng gǔ zi lái wèi yǎng tā de jī wǒ zài zhè wèi nóng mín de jiā lǐ zhù le yì nián
sentences.english: He brought me home, but it was quite unfortunate that he didn’t recognize me.

sentences.simplified: 第二年，有位大学生来到农民家，他看到了我。
sentences.traditional: 第二年，有位大學生來到農民家，他看到了我。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr nián yǒu wèi dà xué shēng lái dào nóng mín jiā tā kàn dào le wǒ
sentences.english: He used me to store grain for feeding his chickens. I lived at this farmer’s house for one year.

sentences.simplified: 我太喜欢这位大学生了，他太有眼光了。
sentences.traditional: 我太喜歡這位大學生了，他太有眼光了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ tài xǐ huan zhè wèi dà xué shēng le tā tài yǒu yǎn guāng le
sentences.english: The following year, a college student came to the farmer’s house, and he saw me.

sentences.simplified: 他看出了我的不同之处，高兴地把我带到了北京。
sentences.traditional: 他看出了我的不同之處，高興地把我帶到了北京。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn chū le wǒ de bù tóng zhī chù gāo xìng de bǎ wǒ dài dào le běi jīng
sentences.english: I liked this college student a lot. He had a very good eye.

sentences.simplified: 后来，经过研究，你们终于知道了我的来历。
sentences.traditional: 後來，經過研究，你們終於知道了我的來歷。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái jīng guò yán jiū nǐ men zhōng yú zhī dào le wǒ de lái lì
sentences.english: He noticed what made me different and happily took me to Beijing.

sentences.simplified: 几千年过去了，很多东西都消失了。
sentences.traditional: 幾千年過去了，很多東西都消失了。
sentences.pinyin: jǐ qiān nián guò qù le hěn duō dōng xi dōu xiāo shī le
sentences.english: Later, after some research, you finally learned where I came from.

sentences.simplified: 我没有对人说过以前的事，
sentences.traditional: 我沒有對人說過以前的事，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu duì rén shuō guò yǐ qián de shì
sentences.english: Several thousand years have passed, and many things have disappeared.

sentences.simplified: 但你们通过自己的研究知道了以前的事，并且还能这样懂我，你们真是太厉害了。
sentences.traditional: 但你們通過自己的研究知道了以前的事，並且還能這樣懂我，你們真是太厲害了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn nǐ men tōng guò zì jǐ de yán jiū zhī dào le yǐ qián de shì bìng qiě hái néng zhè yàng dǒng wǒ nǐ men zhēn shì tài lì hai le
sentences.english: I never told people about the past.
But you knew about my past through your own research and were able to understand me so well. You are really amazing.

sentences.simplified: 现在，我住在北京的“中国国家博物馆”里。这儿是我的新家，我想我会一直在这儿住下去。
sentences.traditional: 現在，我住在北京的“中國國家博物館”裡。這兒是我的新家，我想我會一直在這兒住下去。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài wǒ zhù zài běi jīng de zhōng guó guó jiā bó wù guǎn lǐ zhè‘r shì wǒ de xīn jiā wǒ xiǎng wǒ huì yì zhí zài zhè‘r zhù xià qù

sentences.simplified: 欢迎你来北京看我。
sentences.traditional: 歡迎你來北京看我。
sentences.pinyin: huān yíng nǐ lái běi jīng kàn wǒ
sentences.english: Now, I live in the “National Museum of China” in Beijing. This is my new home, and I think I will live here forever.

sentence_translations: I Am the Eagle-shaped Pottery Ding
Hello, I am a ding dating from between 5,000 and 7,000 years ago.
As for exactly which year, I can’t remember anymore. I’ve lived for too long.
I’ve seen what mankind was like in primitive times, and I have also witnessed the vicissitudes of history.
What do I look like? I think you can already tell.
That’s right, I look like an eagle, and today you call me the “eagle-shaped pottery ding”.
I am very popular because of my cute appearance. Nowadays, you also like to call me a national treasure.
But actually, a long time ago, the first impression I gave people was not cuteness but the domineering aura of a king.
So, please take a closer look at me. Although I’m a little chubby, can you feel the aura of a king from me?
When I was first born, people were still living in thatched huts made from mud and grass.
They raised dogs and pigs, and also farmed the land.
Even though life was simple, everyone had to work very hard to survive.
People used me to hold food and water. I lived with them for many years.
Then, many changes happened. Those people passed away, and I wandered around many places.
I met some people when I was wandering. Among them, there was a lady who liked me a lot.
This lady was a successful person, and everyone respected her.
Later, this lady also died. To accompany her, I was buried in the earth with her.
I slept in the soil, unable to see the sun or the moon.
I slept for several thousand years until 1957, when a farmer discovered me while farming.
He brought me home, but it was quite unfortunate that he didn’t recognize me.
He used me to store grain for feeding his chickens. I lived at this farmer’s house for one year.
The following year, a college student came to the farmer’s house, and he saw me.
I liked this college student a lot. He had a very good eye.
He noticed what made me different and happily took me to Beijing.
Later, after some research, you finally learned where I came from.
Several thousand years have passed, and many things have disappeared.
I never told people about the past.
But you knew about my past through your own research and were able to understand me so well. You are really amazing.
Now, I live in the “National Museum of China” in Beijing. This is my new home, and I think I will live here forever.
You are welcome to visit me in Beijing.
